adaptation.edge_types: native GCN uses directed adjacency without separate relation channels
adaptation.empty_edges: normalize upstream empty edge tensor rank to [2,0], no edges added
adaptation.graph: original Joern CONTROLS/REACHES line projection induced on retained slice lines
adaptation.labels: fixed query/scene benchmark labels, not native any-vulnerable-line XFG labeling
adaptation.model: unmodified pinned official model, statement BiLSTM and GCN/TopK/attention/classifier bodies
adaptation.sanitization: source comments and label-bearing identifiers neutralized before symbolization; external canonical sanitized source reused unchanged
adaptation.slicing: fixed backward benchmark slices, not upstream backward-plus-forward XFG enumeration
adaptation.training_loop: manual equivalent CE/Adam/LambdaLR/clip/DEV loop for modern execution and immutable receipts
adaptation.unit: existing benchmark slice; external score is maximum slice risk per scene
adaptation.word2vec_reproducibility: stable TRAIN row order, one worker and explicit seed/hash seed replace upstream unordered multicore defaults

architecture.graph_encoder: 3 GCNConv256/TopKPooling0.8 stages; GlobalAttention per stage, sum readouts
architecture.statement_encoder: one-layer bidirectional LSTM hidden256, sum direction states, dropout0.5

external.aggregation: maximum slice risk; common cohorts filtered from same predictions

recipe.selection: minimum source DEV mean-of-batch cross-entropy after completed epoch; sample-mean CE also recorded
